{{Quote|Hidden in a copse of dense trees, I found this particular site after falling down a steep hill, crashing face first into the small river below. Interestingly enough, this site seems fairly new. I can't imagine an assignment that would send Imperial officers to such an uncharted area. The minimal amount of damage indicates that the creatures responsible were small.|Excerpt from [[Tinrilo x'Rilsam]]'s log|<ref name="SWG:AEL7" />}}
An '''Imperial survey camp''' was established in an uncharted area of the [[Endor/Legends|Forest moon of Endor]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], not long after the camp was set up, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] survey party was attacked by small creatures. Imperial [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] were forced to flee the camp,<ref name="SWG:AEL7" /> leaving the corpse of one of them behind them.<ref name="SWG" /> A short time later, the explorer [[Tinrilo x'Rilsam]] discovered the abandoned camp while exploring Endor. After studying the damages, he concluded that the Imperial survey party might have been attacked by [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]].<ref name="SWG:AEL7" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial survey camp was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Imperial survey camp was one of many unmarked points of interests on the moon Endor.<ref name="SWG" /> Following the release of the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]'' expansion pack in [[2004]], rare [[W:c:swg:Data Storage Unit|data storage unit]] devices could sometimes be [[W:c:swg:Loot|looted]] during space battles. One such data storage item, named "an Explorer's Log (7/8)," contained a detailed backstory for the Imperial survey party.<ref name="SWG:AEL7" />
